provenance.paper_title: EventMemAgent: Hierarchical Event-Centric Memory for Online Video Understanding with Adaptive Tool Use

evidence.paraphrase: Short-term memory detects event boundaries and reservoir-samples frames in a bounded buffer.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Past observations are archived event by event for later active evidence capture.

Event-granular reservoir sampling bounds the short-term frame buffer. For EventMemAgent, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of event-granular short-term frame buffer.
Detected events are consolidated into the long-term archive. For EventMemAgent, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of event-granular short-term frame buffer.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (event-granular short-term frame buffer) changes through explicit deletion or eviction of stored items, episodic or hierarchical summarization; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
